item.title: Version 1.1
item.description:
The Tracker themes now look the way they do in Tracker.

  • Each theme's page is one of its Tracker cards, with the same paper gradient, edge, shadow, and glow
  • Matrix: real falling code behind the page, glowing titles, and a green glow while you write
  • Dune: the glowing desert sky with a backlit dune and drifting sand, on a sandstone page with a low-sun shadow
  • Blueprint: proper graph paper, with a heavier line every fifth square
  • Midnight: a frosted-glass page over the night sky. Neon: a bright pink edge that glows
  • Code blocks now use each theme's own colors

item.title: Version 1.0
item.description:
The first release of Marker, a Typora-style Markdown editor.

  • Live preview as you write, plus source mode, an outline, and export to HTML or PDF.
  • Themes: Themes › offers Plain (the default), Night, Newsprint, and Solarized Light, then Classic, Library, Midnight, Blueprint, Sunday, Neon, Field, Matrix, Sorbet, and Dune. A saved Auto or GitHub choice becomes Plain.
  • Updates: Marker checks for new versions on its own. You can also choose Marker › Check for Updates… at any time.
